actual_answer: A Mediterranean diet helps reduce cardiovascular disease risk factors such as visceral fat and triglycerides, as shown in RCTs. It improves adherence to the diet and enhances metabolic health, as demonstrated in long-term studies. The Mediterranean diet is associated with better cardiovascular outcomes, including reduced coronary heart disease and stroke rates. [1] [2] [3]
